summary: Nền tảng self-hosted mã nguồn mở để deploy ứng dụng và quản lý cơ sở dữ liệu, là thay thế cho Vercel, Netlify và Heroku.
usecases: Self-hosted deployment of web applications on personal VPS
Managed database deployment and backup for hosted projects
CI/CD pipeline automation for containerized applications
ideas: Adding built-in domain management and SSL automation
Integrating with GitHub Actions for push-to-deploy workflows
Creating a marketplace of one-click app templates for quick deployment
